name: directus
description: Production Zerops deployment recipes, multi-service topologies, RAG pgvector hooks, and telemetry seeders for Directus 11+

zerops_yaml_directus.description: Production zerops.yaml for Directus 11+ on Node.js 24 (Ubuntu glibc) with PostgreSQL 18, Valkey, and Shared Storage
zerops_yaml_directus.yaml:
zerops:
  - setup: directus
    build:
      os: ubuntu
      prepareCommands:
        - sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates build-essential python3
        - npm install directus @directus/extensions-sdk sharp
      deployFiles:
        - node_modules
        - package.json
        - extensions
        - uploads
      cache:
        - node_modules
    run:
      os: ubuntu
      prepareCommands:
        - sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ffmpeg curl ca-certificates
        - sudo mkdir -p /mnt/baiostorage/directus/uploads 2>/dev/null || true
        - sudo chmod -R 777 /mnt/baiostorage/directus/uploads 2>/dev/null || true
      initCommands:
        - zsc execOnce ${appVersionId} --retryUntilSuccessful -- npx directus bootstrap
      start: npx directus start
      ports:
        - port: 8055
          httpSupport: true
      envVariables:
        PORT: "8055"
        HOST: "0.0.0.0"
        DB_CLIENT: "pg"
        DB_CONNECTION_STRING: "${db_connectionString}"
        CACHE_ENABLED: "true"
        CACHE_STORE: "redis"
        CACHE_REDIS: "${cache_connectionString}"
        CACHE_AUTO_PURGE: "true"
        SYNCHRONIZATION_STORE: "redis"
        MESSENGER_STORE: "redis"
        WEBSOCKETS_ENABLED: "true"
        STORAGE_LOCATIONS: "local"
        STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT: "/mnt/baiostorage/directus/uploads"
